body:
Today an invite reaches its addressee only as a URL they have to be handed and paste, even when they already have an account. The overview should show the invites addressed to the signed-in email, below the lists, so people see them on their main screen and join or ignore right there.

Server: `GET /invites/pending` — the caller's live invites (email match, case-insensitive; not used, revoked or expired; list live and not closed; caller not already a member), each with the list's name and kind, the inviter's initials, `expires_at` and the token. Returning the token to its own addressee is what the URL does anyway, and it admits only that email. Joining reuses `POST /invites/redeem`.

Clients (web + Android): an "Invitations" section under the lists, one card per invite — kind icon, list name, "From AL", "Expires in 5 d" — with Join and Ignore. Join redeems, pulls the list and opens it. Ignore is client-side only: the invite moves to a greyed "Ignored" section at the very bottom, where Join is still offered, so a change of mind costs nothing; the decision is remembered on the device. Fetched when the overview opens and on refresh; offline it simply is not shown, like the members screen.

Nine locales on both clients, wire contract updated.
title: Show pending invites on the overview, with Join and Ignore
